findingFairplay: At least one Mach-O slice has cryptid 1. FairPlay protection remains and cannot be removed by editing or re-signing.

2. Save prepared IPA to iPhone Files.
3. Open LiveContainer, tap + and import from Files.
4. Keep track of the host app's 7-day refresh.

toolConfirmSideStoreDesc:
• Standalone SideStore (official latest release) with its own Home Screen icon.
• Uses 1 free Personal Team app slot (2 slots if paired with standalone LiveContainer).
• Requires LocalDevVPN on iPhone for wireless refresh.
toolConfirmLCSSDesc:
• Integrated LiveContainer + SideStore bundle (nightly channel) with built-in SideStore.
• Uses only 1 free Personal Team app slot and shares certificates inside the same sandbox.
• Refreshing the LiveContainer host every 7 days refreshes both.

• Standalone LiveContainer host (nightly channel), using 1 free Personal Team app slot.
• Best when standalone SideStore is already installed; import certificate from SideStore in Settings.

lcAdvancedMultiDesc: In LiveContainer, open the app card → Settings → Convert to Shared App so it can run alongside other apps in multi-task / multi-container mode.
lcAdvancedShortcutTitle: 2. Add a Home Screen icon via iOS Shortcuts (7 steps)
lcAdvancedShortcutSteps:
1. Open LiveContainer → Apps and long-press the app.
2. Tap Add to Home Screen → Save App Icon, pick a style and save.
3. Long-press again → Add to Home Screen → Copy Launch URL.
4. Open Apple Shortcuts and tap + to create a new shortcut.
5. Search for Launch App and pick the LiveContainer action.
6. Tap Launch URL, paste the copied URL, and run once to test.
7. Tap Share → Add to Home Screen, set the name, and pick the saved icon. (iOS sandbox requires Shortcuts on device for Home Screen icons.)
